main_text.p: divelles : tecum ascendet in cathedram, tecum sedebit in tribunali, sub toga tecum erit & sub saga, tecum deportabitur ad Sarmatas, tecum revertetur in Patriam. Dum nativam indolem recudere studet Exercitium, inanem pascit fine successu Credulitatem : periculum faciente, & profectus speci-men requirente Casu, non respondebit Eventus: multa præmeditatum, multa consultum destituet in arena Fiducia ; Huic tamen abeunti, si vicariam feceris Pertinaciam, depromet hæc de duro penu tetricum quiddam & invitum, quod adstringit astantium Ingenuitatem, & tædio vexat, & mille modis importunum est : Mussitanus, caput scalpimus impatientes, & inter abeundum oggerimus illud Poëtæ.

page.notes: Catchword "Scili-" is set at the right as the hyphenated start of the next word, transcribed as printed in the text. Left-margin fragments are show-through or edge of the neighbouring page and are omitted. Words "Casu,non" and "Eventus:multa" are printed without space.
